subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Birth of the SEC
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Birth of the SEC usable.

hook.text: Before 1934, companies could lie to investors with almost no legal consequences.

buildup.text: The 1929 stock market crash exposed rampant manipulation, insider trading, and false reporting.

discovery.text: Congress created the SEC in 1934 to regulate securities markets and protect investors.

twist.text: The first SEC chairman was Joseph Kennedy — a man who'd profited from the very practices he was hired to stop.

climax.text: The SEC's creation established that markets need rules — and someone to enforce them.

punchline.text: They hired a fox to guard the henhouse. Surprisingly, it worked.

quiz.question: What event led to the creation of the SEC?
